title: 'Market is becoming more discerning': Wall Street weighs next catalyst for AI trade
title_zh: “市场变得更加挑剔”：华尔街正在权衡人工智能交易的下一个催化剂
summary: Wall Street is looking toward earnings for a follow-through of the AI trade.
summary_zh: 华尔街正在关注人工智能交易的后续收益。

title: Big Tech is paying for the AI boom, and chipmakers are cashing in: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 大型科技公司正在为人工智能的繁荣付出代价，芯片制造商正在获利：每日图表
summary: Wall Street knows Big Tech can spend on AI — the harder question is how fast that spending turns back into cash.
summary_zh: 华尔街知道大型科技公司可以在人工智能上进行投资——更难的问题是这些支出以多快的速度变回现金。
